_comment: U8 freshness suite (plan B3). Each case is a script of steps against a fixture repo (git init + 3 tracked files + project.json with required 'test' and optional 'lint', exempt ['**/*.md','docs/**']). Step verbs: edit <path>, add-u, add <path>, stage <path>, commit, verify <name> pass|fail|timeout (synthesized VerifyRecord with S computed by TreeS at that moment), verify-running <name>, mutate-during-verify <path>, checkout <ref>, reset-hard, other-session-edit <path>, worktree-b. 'fresh' is the expected verify_fresh value of a PreToolUse FreshQuery{Kind: commit, Git: <git node of argv>, Cwd: fixture root}. 'check' is the expected `verify --check` exit code (commit mode) IN THE PRE-COMMIT ENVIRONMENT: the harness installs a fixture .git/hooks/pre-commit that copies $GIT_INDEX_FILE to a temp file, records its own cwd, and exits 1 (aborting the commit); it then runs `git <argv>` and calls evidence.Check(opt, <recorded cwd>, CheckOptions{Mode: commit, IndexFile: <copy>}) and maps the result with the architecture §7 table. Hence for 'git commit -a'/'git commit <paths>' C is the index git was about to commit (p3 ⇒ 0). Case 7: '../other' is a SECOND fixture repo (sibling directory, same project.json, no verify records); git runs the hook with cwd = ../other, so check uses ../other's project.json and evidence (no record ⇒ 11), and verify_fresh resolves the -C target to ../other (no_record ⇒ false). Case 6: 'worktree-b' adds a linked worktree (git worktree add) whose repo_inst differs; argv runs there.

counter_examples.desc: later failed verify supersedes earlier pass
verified in worktree A, commit in worktree B
partial staging: unstaged tracked change, plain commit

positives.desc: only exempt files changed after pass

consistency.desc: S == C(all) == C(plain after add -u) == git add -u && git rm --cached exempt && git write-tree
